page.overview:
Who is Ariks Eshteross?

Lord Ariks Eshteross () was an orc nobleman and former mercenary living in Jrusar, Marquet. As an NPC, he was played by Matthew Mercer.

Lord Eshteross was an older orc with grayish skin. He had gray, receding hair that was bald on top and a well trimmed Van Dyke goatee and beard on a scarred face. He stood about 6'2" and had broad shoulders and a wide neck. He was also described as handsome with a cunning look in his eyes.

He walked with a cane, and when first encountered, he was wearing a pair of spectacles, a deep crimson-burgundy high-collared robe, and a scarf around his shoulders.

He was described by Bertrand Bell as having a strange manner. Bertrand also believed that Eshteross was "interested in preserving the good folk of Jrusar" and wanting to see good done in the city.
